question: In August 2022, Rameshbabu Praggnanandhaa, the 17-year-old Indian Chess master, defeated world champion Magnus Carlsen in the last round of the FTX Crypto Cup in _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Miami**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In August 2022, Rameshbabu Praggnanandhaa, an Indian chess prodigy, defeated reigning world champion Magnus Carlsen in the final round of the FTX Crypto Cup.
 
• The tournament took place in Miami, Florida, USA, marking a significant achievement in Praggnanandhaa's career.
 
• Praggnanandhaa, who was only 17 years old at the time, showcased his exceptional skills against one of the best chess players in the world.
 
• The victory over Carlsen was a highlight in the FTX Crypto Cup, demonstrating Praggnanandhaa's potential to become one of the top players in the chess world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **FTX Crypto Cup:**

 
 
• The FTX Crypto Cup is part of the Meltwater Champions Chess Tour, a prestigious series of online chess tournaments.
 
• It features some of the world's top grandmasters competing in rapid format games.
 
• The tournament is sponsored by FTX, a cryptocurrency exchange platform.
 
• The event aims to blend the excitement of chess with the emerging world of cryptocurrency.
 
 
 
• **Magnus Carlsen:**
 
 
• Magnus Carlsen is a Norwegian chess grandmaster who has been the reigning World Chess Champion since 2013.
 
• He is widely considered one of the greatest chess players of all time.
 
• Carlsen has held the No. 1 position in the FIDE world chess rankings for the longest period.
 
• He is known for his deep understanding of chess, exceptional endgame skills, and versatile playing style.
 
 
 
• **Rameshbabu Praggnanandhaa:**
 
 
• Rameshbabu Praggnanandhaa is an Indian chess grandmaster who achieved the title at the age of 12, becoming one of the youngest to do so.
 
• He has consistently performed well in both national and international tournaments.
 
• Praggnanandhaa is known for his aggressive playing style and tactical prowess.
 
• His victory against Carlsen in the FTX Crypto Cup was a significant milestone in his career.
